svg.text: T W I N G A B L E S C O U R T Y A R D
B — Private garden suites and dressing buffer
PROPOSED 2D LAYOUT / Two primary suites + office / three baths / 2,800 sq ft enclosed, excluding courtyard
Proposed 2D layout, unbuilt and not native-verified. Both sleeping rooms sit behind street-facing dressing/bath buffers; wider wings support
mixed dressing and a working pantry.
Both king rooms move behind the street-facing dressing/bath buffers for privacy; they lose direct front-gable bedroom glazing.
The courtyard is narrower and longer (16 × 32 ft); side-room planning width grows to 19 ft, but the rear public band is about 15 ft 5 in deep.
Overall envelope: 62'-0" x 53'-5"; open court: 512 sq ft; enclosed: 2,800 sq ft.
Proposed 2D arrangement for selection; no native model has been rebuilt or engineering confirmed.
CONCEPT DESIGN / Dimensions govern; do not scale. Site, products and engineering unverified.
